description: This file defines the ImapHandlerInterface interface, which specifies the methods any IMAP handler class must implement to interact with mailboxes and messages via IMAP protocol. It includes method signatures for checking availability, opening/closing connections, retrieving errors, fetching emails, managing mailboxes, and other IMAP operations.

classes.name: ImapHandlerInterface
classes.description: Interface defining the contract for IMAP handler classes, outlining methods for mailbox and message management via IMAP.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the IMAP handler is available.

methods.name: isValidStream
methods.description: Validates if the provided stream resource is valid.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns an array of errors encountered.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a mailbox connection with given credentials and options.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Checks if the connection is still alive.

methods.name: reopen
methods.description: Reopens a mailbox connection with optional new mailbox and options.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the raw connection resource or object.

methods.name: setTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout for IMAP operations.

methods.name: getMailboxes
methods.description: Retrieves list of mailboxes matching reference and pattern.

methods.name: getHeaderInfo
methods.description: Retrieves header info for a message.

methods.name: fetchHeader
methods.description: Fetches header data for a message.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a message to a mailbox.

methods.name: getUid
methods.description: Gets UID for a message number.

methods.name: getNumberOfMessages
methods.description: Returns count of messages in current mailbox.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Retrieves the body of a message.

methods.name: utf7Encode
methods.description: Encodes mailbox name in modified UTF-7.

methods.name: getMessageList
methods.description: Retrieves list of messages with various criteria.
